The band's {route} for /admin is 'Overview', SCR-120's PageHeader (§6 L250; D02:278 'Admin area · Overview'); §4 L166 fills it only for Users.

The Audit tile's audited-read marker (D9 L122): §14 keys no string for it; D02:707 gives 'Viewing this log is recorded — Audit log viewed (admin.audit_read)' (inherited, L17-18): a placeholder marks its place until §14 keys it (a §14 gap).

The announcement: §14 has no announce.* key for a tile or component entering degraded or recovering (L600); D02:690 gives 'Health: bybit_private_ws degraded.' / 'Health: bybit_private_ws healthy again.' (inherited, L17-18): annotated, not drawn (a §14 gap).

Spec question (D8): OV-4 shows Recorder and storage loading beside Users in error, but both are slices of the one GET /admin/overview call ('the AdminOverview slices are one call', D8 L121; L260, L263, L266), which cannot be pending and answered at once; drawn as the row says. Proposed spec fix (review 24 item 6a): in L277, make the loading tile one with its own read that OV-4 otherwise leaves fresh, Audit (GET /admin/audit?limit=3, L268); Recorder and storage then reads fresh and the board moves its CMP-015 to Audit.

Spec question (strip): D02 D4's 'the "Needs your action" strip repeats a down item' (D02:182) has no strip.* key (§14 L598), and deviation (7) (L28-40) does not supersede it, so the strip reads strip.none beside three down tiles. Proposed spec fix (review 24 item 6b): key the item in §14's strip.* row, or add D02:182's strip clause to deviation (7); the board keeps strip.none until then.

Spec question (G-T2): cap.recorded ends '[Change]' (L605), which opens Record tier 'from the strip or the Accounts tile' (OV-8, L281), and Record tier needs neither used nor the meter (dlg.tier, L609); cap.used_unavailable (L605) names no action, so the control vanishes with the state (G-T2 makes a state-gated control E09-D09's T2, which has no hidden-by-state form). Drawn as §14 keys it. Proposed spec fix (review 24 item 7): append ' [Change]' to cap.used_unavailable, or draw the T2 form (lock glyph, full label 'Change', an admin.* reason). The same question applies to cap.tier_unavailable (board 33).
